notes.title: Demo Released!
notes.notes:
The demo for Shmooblin Blaster has released!

It contains the first two bosses of the game for you to try out, and a little feedback survey where you can report bugs and say how the game feels as a whole.

I hope everyone enjoys and this gets you hyped for the full release!
